arguments.rule_content:
rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_SvchostUpdate {
    meta:
        description = "Detects Cobalt Strike beacon using svchost_update.exe pattern"
        author = "SOC Team"
        hash = "a1b2c3d4e5f6"
        malware_family = "CobaltStrike.Beacon"
    strings:
        $beacon_config = { 6a 40 68 00 30 00 00 6a 00 6a 00 50 e8 } 
        $http_get = "GET / HTTP/1.1" 
        $user_agent = "Mozilla/4.0 (compatible; MSIE 6.1; Windows NT)"
    condition:
        $beacon_config and $http_get and $user_agent
}
